scope: native standard AecPreProcess through error checkpoint with real run decision, then complete ordinary AecRun with real brightness controller
limitations: DCG and register-value conversion are explicit successful no-op boundaries; call counts are checked.
Fixed target curve 45, standard mean mode, explicitly seeded runtime/policy and associated exposure; manual/HDR/iris/environment history excluded.
Successful control paths only; conversion failures and partially mutated error state are not covered.
No live writes or physical frame association are introduced.
Preprocessing stops at the current-error checkpoint; conversion and result publication are external.
